question: On which upper body parts are the mantra syllables to be placed?
premises: Syllables are to be placed on the body.
The head, forehead, eyes, and ears are specified.
The nose, mouth, and chin are also included.
inference: The syllables are placed on the head, forehead, eyes, ears, nose, mouth, and chin.
plain_english: Place them on the head, forehead, the two eyes, the two ears, and also on the nose, mouth, and chin.
